name: Cheesy Veggie Ground & Cilantro-Lime Cauliflower Rice Burrito Bowl
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggie ground and spices; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic. Once the veggie ground is done, add the garlic and stir to combine. Transfer to a medium bowl and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Return skillet to medium-high heat, add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring often, until it begins to soften, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, cut the cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate the cauliflower.
Add cauliflower and spices to the skillet with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cauliflower is lightly golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes more.
While the cauliflower is cooking, coarsely grate the cheese.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Cut one of the lime into wedges, reserve the other lime for the cauliflower rice.

When the cauliflower rice is done, juice remaining lime into the skillet. Add cilantro and veggie ground; gently stir to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide cauliflower rice mixture between plates or bowls and top with grated cheese, tomatoes, and avocado. Garnish with lime wedges and enjoy!
author: Mealime
